healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the AgentMail API key with GET /v0/auth/me.

inboxes.list.title: List inboxes
inboxes.list.description: List AgentMail inboxes available to the current API key.

messages.list.title: List messages
messages.list.description: List messages in an AgentMail inbox.

messages.get.title: Get message
messages.get.description: Get a single message from an AgentMail inbox.

inboxes.create.title: Create inbox
inboxes.create.description: Create an AgentMail inbox with optional username, domain, and display name.

username.description: Inbox username. Randomly generated if omitted.

domain.description: Verified sending domain. Defaults to agentmail.to.

display_name.description: Display name shown on outbound mail.

status.description: Create the inbox active or paused.

inboxes.update.title: Update inbox
inboxes.update.description: Update an AgentMail inbox display name or pause/resume status.

messages.send.title: Send message
messages.send.description: Send an email from an AgentMail inbox.

track_opens.description: Inject open tracking on HTML sends.

messages.reply.title: Reply to message
messages.reply.description: Reply to a message in an AgentMail inbox.

messages.delete.title: Delete message
messages.delete.description: Delete a message from an AgentMail inbox.

threads.list.title: List threads
threads.list.description: List conversation threads in an AgentMail inbox.

threads.get.title: Get thread
threads.get.description: Get a single AgentMail conversation thread.

drafts.list.title: List drafts
drafts.list.description: List drafts in an AgentMail inbox.

drafts.create.title: Create draft
drafts.create.description: Create a draft in an AgentMail inbox.

in_reply_to.description: Message id this draft replies to.

drafts.send.title: Send draft
drafts.send.description: Send a previously created AgentMail draft.

domains.list.title: List domains
domains.list.description: List AgentMail sending domains available to the current API key.

domains.get.title: Get domain
domains.get.description: Get a single AgentMail sending domain.

pods.list.title: List pods
pods.list.description: List AgentMail pods used for multi-tenant isolation.

inboxes.api_keys.create.title: Create inbox API key
inboxes.api_keys.create.description: Create an inbox-scoped AgentMail API key. The full secret is returned once.

expires_at.description: Future expiration time. Omitted, the key inherits the authenticating key's expiry.

permissions.description: Permission flags. Omit the object to grant every permission the inbox scope allows. When present, only flags set to true are granted.

inboxes.api_keys.list.title: List inbox API keys
inboxes.api_keys.list.description: List API key metadata scoped to an AgentMail inbox. Secrets are not returned.

limit.description: Limit of number of items returned.

inboxes.events.list.title: List inbox events
inboxes.events.list.description: List label-change events for an AgentMail inbox, newest first unless ascending is set.

limit.description: Limit of number of items returned.

inboxes.metrics.events.query.title: Query inbox event metrics
inboxes.metrics.events.query.description: Query timestamped email-event counts for an AgentMail inbox.

event_types.description: Metric event types to query. Each value is sent as a repeated query parameter.

start.description: Start timestamp. Must be within the last 90 days.

end.description: End timestamp. A future end is clamped to now.

period.description: Bucket size in whole seconds. Omit for individual event counts.

limit.description: Limit on number of buckets to return.

drafts.update.title: Update draft
drafts.update.description: Edit fields on an AgentMail draft. Omitted fields stay unchanged. An empty recipient list clears that field.

reply_to.description: Reply-to addresses. Pass an empty list to clear them.

to.description: Recipient addresses. Pass an empty list to clear them.

cc.description: CC addresses. Pass an empty list to clear them.

bcc.description: BCC addresses. Pass an empty list to clear them.

text.description: Plain text body of the draft.

url.description: URL AgentMail can download without custom authentication headers or cookies.

add_attachments.description: Attachments to add. Provide content or url on each item.

send_at.description: Time at which to schedule sending the draft.
